passage:
An old sports stadium was no longer used for major games. The city considered tearing it down.
Local groups suggested turning it into a community space. The field became a public park. Rooms under the seats became classrooms, dance studios, and small shops. Some seats were left to show the stadium's past.
The project saved money and reduced construction waste.
Visitors could still feel the old excitement of games, but the place now served people every day.
The stadium's story changed from competition to community. Reuse showed that large buildings do not have to become empty shells when their first purpose ends.
